# Crest development build
[Download Crest for Mac (Apple silicon)](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/releases/download/development/Installer-Crest-0.4.2-development-2026-08-18-986bee7-arm64.dmg)
Built from [`986bee7`](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/commit/986bee77f3e4331c5ab0f619a225a6a8aa97d1b2).
Development builds are signed and notarized, but may be less reliable than stable releases.
## Changes since the previous development build

### fix(release): stamp Xcode Cloud build number
[View commit `a3dafaa`](https://github.com/pauljoda/Crest/commit/a3dafaa9e5581f77640ad9fba5c808f47c5a3d1b)
### Add monthly sponsor recognition tiers (#11)
## What changed
- add a ranked public sponsor roll for Sponsor, Sustainer, and Supporter members - explain the recognition boundaries in the README and support guide - point the website and Help Center sponsorship links directly to the Ko-fi tiers - replace the README marketing tagline with a plain description of Crest
## Why
Ko-fi now offers simple recurring support without invented content perks. The only distinction between tiers is optional public recognition, and sponsorship does not buy access, endorsement, support priority, ownership, or roadmap influence.
## Validation
- `npm run build:website` - `python3 Scripts/Tests/test_product_site.py` — 24 passed - `Scripts/check-public-source.py` - `git diff --check`
Signed-off-by: Paul Davis <pauldavis101@gmail.com>
